The '''wardrobe warehouse''' was a facility located in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] servicing the needs of the members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sent on undercover missions. Circa [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Taria Damsin]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] visited the Warehouse before departing on their [[Mission to Corellia (Clone Wars)|Mission to Corellia]] to properly disguise themselves as tourists on [[Corellia/Legends|the planet]].<ref name="CWG:S" />
